symptoms: Severe Exacerbation: Pulse > 120, SpO2 < 90%, pH < 7.20, PO2 < 60, PEFR < 50%.
Mild Exacerbation: Dyspnoea, increased sputum volume/purulence.

management_steps.details: Hydrocortisone 200mg IV STAT. MgSO4 25-50mg/kg IV over 20 min. Continuous nebulized bronchodilators. NIV (BiPAP/CPAP). RSI if failing (Ketamine 1mg/kg load, then 0.15mg/kg/hr infusion).
Prednisone 0.5mg/kg daily x 7 days. Salbutamol MDI 2 puffs PRN. Beclomethasone (Beclate) MDI 2 puffs BD. Augmentin 1g BD x 7 days + Azithromycin 500mg OD x 3 days.
